answer: Each identity must forge one ferrous beacon tuned to a distinct oasis well: the beacon's iron core costs 50 credits, and tuning against every earlier beacon adds 4 credits per existing beacon, so fake k pays 50 + 4(k-1). Ten fakes pay 680; a hundred pay 24,800. Two beacons sharing one well jam each other's signal and both are struck, so the cost cannot be pooled across clones.
